description: This file defines an in-memory demo backend simulation used for testing purposes. It provides methods to generate cookies and tokens, and to perform CRUD-like operations on a list of job titles, including listing, creating, and deleting entries. The class is designed for mocking backend responses in API testing scenarios.

classes.name: DemoBackend
classes.description: A utility class that simulates backend behavior for testing purposes, managing in-memory job titles and session tokens.

methods.name: demoCookiesFor
methods.description: Generates demo Cookies for a given username, ensuring cookies are deterministic for testing.

methods.name: demoBearerTokenFor
methods.description: Returns a deterministic demo bearer token for a given username.

methods.name: listJobTitles
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of job titles stored in-memory, with total count, limit, and offset metadata.

methods.name: createJobTitle
methods.description: Creates a new job title entry with provided details and adds it to the in-memory list, returning the created record.

methods.name: deleteJobTitles
methods.description: Deletes job titles with specified IDs and returns the list of deleted IDs or an error if the input is invalid.
